entities.name: The Great Throne of Glory (Enoch 14:18)
entities.description: Enoch 14:18 - 'I looked and saw therein a lofty throne; its appearance was like crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.'

entities.name: The Great House of Crystal & Fire (Enoch 14:10)
entities.description: Enoch 14:10 - 'And I went into that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice... Its floor was of fire and its ceiling was flashing lightning and cherubim.'

entities.name: River of Flaming Fire (East)
entities.description: Enoch 14:19 - 'From underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon.'

entities.name: River of Flaming Fire (West)
entities.description: Enoch 71:2 - 'And I saw streams of fire, and those streams were like rivers of fire and surrounded that house.'

entities.name: Central Mountain of Alabaster (Enoch 24:1)
entities.description: Enoch 24:1 - 'I went to another place of the earth, and he showed me a mountain range of fire which burnt day and night.'

entities.name: Peak of Sapphire Stone (Enoch 24:2)
entities.description: Enoch 24:2 - 'And the seventh mountain was in the midst of these, and it excelled them in height, resembling the seat of a throne: and fragrant trees encircled the throne.'

entities.name: Archangel Michael (Enoch 20:5)
entities.description: Enoch 20:5 - 'Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.'

entities.name: Archangel Uriel (Enoch 20:2)
entities.description: Enoch 20:2 - 'Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.'

entities.name: Archangel Raphael (Enoch 20:3)
entities.description: Enoch 20:3 - 'Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.'

entities.name: Tree of Life / Fragrant Tree (Enoch 24:4)
entities.description: Enoch 24:4 - 'And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it until the great judgement... Its fruit shall be for the elect.'
